content.title: The Art of Leap Attacks
content.body:
§o"A torn page from Ancient Battle Techniques"§r 
    
    ...many warriors have too much weight on their armor to move swiftly, but leaping is still useful to them.
    Dodges allow to avoid undesired damage, though they are also useful to end a fight earlier...
    ...§o"Leap Attacks"§r, when warriors §ododge from the ground§r, then §oattack while falling§r. The more times the enemy is hit in a row, the better the warrior's rythm gets, increasing the force of every strike. How much damage is done from leap attacks varies from fighter to fighter, but the average person could perform up to 8 consecutive strikes, before reaching their strength limit... 
    Over time, even commoners can learn to implement Leap Attacks in their battles too, but without proper training and technique, they will get exhausted.
